subject: 陵川西溪二仙庙后殿（正殿）
caption: 西溪二仙庙 · 后殿
金代 · 1142年起重建
source_note: 采用后殿正面实拍，剔除树木、香炉与现代设施，保留三间前廊、斗栱与台阶。局部被枝叶遮挡的轮廓仅按可见延续线整理；不作为考古复原或测绘图。仅描绘后殿，不含梳妆楼与前部明清建筑。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line architectural heritage illustration for 访古.
Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER: existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its delicate, elegant, slightly organic fine black lines, very restrained interior detail, wide empty white surfaces and generous margins. Image 2 is ONLY SUBJECT GEOMETRY: the actual front facade of the Jin-period rear/main hall (后殿/正殿) at Xixi Erxian Temple, Lingchuan, Shanxi, China.
Draw this exact compact hall as a sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing, near-front view matching the photograph, horizontal ridge, vertical columns. Preserve THREE bays with two prominent slender square front columns between bays and the corner columns, the recessed wood door/screen wall, the open central doorway, the low stone platform and central short steps. Preserve the real single-eaved hip-and-gable roof, its shallow upward-curving eave and the two upstanding ridge-end ornaments, using selected thin contour shapes. Preserve the photograph's bracket grouping and deep eave proportions. This is the rear hall alone, NOT the flanking tall dressing towers, not the front gate.
Remove foliage, incense burner, foreground furniture, fire extinguishers, neighboring buildings, people, all modern signs, calligraphy, and decorative painted narratives. Where vegetation intersects the hall retain only the evident continuation of its roof and facade, not an invented extension. The building should read as this broad, low three-bay Jin hall.
Stylistic economy is essential: the large roof surface is almost entirely white with at most 14 widely spaced thin descending lines, no crosswise tile seams, no repeating tile arcs. Wall and platform surfaces stay white with only edges and a few block joints, no brick texture. Doors/windows stay WHITE with thin outlined lattice: simplify into a few widely spaced straight bars, NO tiny black cells, no checkerboard. Central doorway is a white opening with one or two structural interior contours, NEVER filled black. Draw brackets and beam profiles selectively as clear fine outlines; do not densely hatch.
No grey tones, solid black shading, cast shadows, crosshatching, pencil grain, stippling, photoreal texture, color, gold, text, labels, watermark, border, or scenery. Only a few short thin ground lines. Landscape canvas 1536×1024; whole roof apex, eaves and complete platform uncut, building centered at around 82% canvas width with comfortable clear whitespace all around. All dark photo areas become white outlined surfaces.

historical_sources.title: 陵川古建
historical_sources.evidence: 西溪二仙庙正殿及梳妆楼保留金代风格；正殿三间六椽、单檐歇山，金大定五年等有修葺记录。页面亦有其他二仙庙，取西溪段。

historical_sources.title: 西溪二仙庙古建筑调查
historical_sources.evidence: 金大定五年1165《重修真泽二仙庙碑》记皇统二年1142开始重建；该年为重建开始，不称竣工年。

historical_sources.title: 跟着“悟空”游西溪！
historical_sources.evidence: 西溪二仙庙后殿与梳妆楼属于重要金代建筑，作为实景采集对象。

coordinates.note: 西溪二仙庙古迹位置，非陵川县城中心。

site_recommendation.name: 陵川西溪二仙庙
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1142为碑记重建起始纪年，并非后殿精确竣工年；现存主体按金代风格断代。
site_recommendation.place: 山西陵川 · 崇文镇岭常村西
site_recommendation.lede: 西溪二仙庙的后殿用三间前廊托起宽阔屋檐，斗栱在檐下连续展开。正殿与两侧梳妆楼保留金代形制，也留下晋东南二仙信仰的建筑印记。

facts.label: 金代后殿
facts.text: 碑记载1142年开始重建，现存正殿与梳妆楼保留金代风格；庙内其余建筑多属明清。

facts.label: 三间六椽
facts.text: 后殿置于石台基上，面阔三间、进深六椽，单檐歇山顶，门前保留前廊。

facts.label: 二仙信仰
facts.text: 庙宇祭祀二仙，正殿两旁另设二层三檐梳妆楼；本图仅转绘后殿正面。
